        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RolloutSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SolutionSupported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToAssess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request for compatibility, cost and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToAssess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessToApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approved" name="Request approved?">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToProcure</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToRollout</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToRollout</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToRollout" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RolloutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RolloutToTrainingDecision" sourceRef="Task_RolloutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingNeeded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupportToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProvideSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_SolutionSupported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT Solution Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Requesting Employee or Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ChecksSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateCostResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ChecksJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RolloutSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SolutionSupported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for IT solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ChecksSplit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCompatibility</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCostResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckCompatibility" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCompatibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompatibilityToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateCostResources" name="Evaluate cost and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCostResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CostResourcesToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ChecksJoin">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompatibilityToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CostResourcesToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approved" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToProcure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToNotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToNotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToProcure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToRollout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RolloutSolution" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToRollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RolloutToTrainingDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RolloutToTrainingDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingSkip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Training decision merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingSkip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToSupport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideSupport" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToSupport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SupportToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SolutionSupported" name="Solution in use with IT support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupportToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToSplit" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ChecksSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompatibility" sourceRef="Gateway_ChecksSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCostResources" sourceRef="Gateway_ChecksSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCostResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompatibilityToJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Gateway_ChecksJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostResourcesToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCostResources" targetRef="Gateway_ChecksJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_ChecksJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToProcure" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToNotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcureToInstall" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallToTest" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToRollout" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RolloutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RolloutToTrainingDecision" sourceRef="Task_RolloutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingYes" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingDecision" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingSkip" name="Training skipped" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToSupport" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_ProvideSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupportToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProvideSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_SolutionSupported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
